annotations.text:
/explore — GET /api/challenges
List left, sticky map right. Band chips double as the filter and the legend.
The redaction banner is shown because the list response carries redacted: true for anyone who is not a coordinator.

/impact — GET /api/dashboard/metrics plus GET /api/ledger/verify
Bars carry a CSS-only hover tooltip, no JS needed.
The funnel's amber note is the data_warnings component: team_formed sits below piloted because older seeded rows have no team_formed_at.

Band colours were re-stepped from your ramps so adjacent pairs stay apart for colourblind readers:
critical #6842A6, high #D9A514, moderate #256FA8, long term #42BCBC.
Chips keep the darker text steps. Every band also carries its name, never colour alone.
